title: Round at a Clause Marker
statement: Let $x,p,r$ be bit strings and $j$ a natural number. If $x$ is the concatenation of $p$, the bit $1$, and $r$, then one round from the state with fresh cursor $j$, consumed length $|p|$, and formula phase emits $[1]$ and moves to consumed length $|p|+1$, leaving the cursor unchanged and entering phase $1$.
replaced:
Let the input be $p \mathbin{+\!\!+} 1 :: r$ and the seam state have consumed
$|p|$ bits in the formula phase. The round emits $[1]$, consumes one bit, and
moves to the first-literal phase.
